items.level_reason: The official study-choice conversation type: a two-figure sum (q4), a rule applied to a third person (q5), advice against the speaker's own proposal (q6), an opinion with a 'maar' structure (q3) and a whole-text inference whose key word 'zekerheid' is never said (q7); paraphrase between prompt and fragment in q2, q4, q6, q7; conditionals with inversion and relative clauses; q1 on the easy side because its key is nearly literal.
items.natural_dutch: Conversational throughout ('Eén avond, dat is te doen.', 'Dat is een flink verschil.', 'Eerlijk gezegd twijfel ik.'); adviser 'je', student 'u'; no filler, no digits, longest sentence 20 words. Optional only: the intro says 'overdag' twice; q3 'Vraag dat eerst na op je werk' right after 'duidelijk gezegd dat hij een diploma wil' (replacement given); 'Hoewel die langer duurt en meer kost, heb ik dan …' is the most written turn but is the q7 evidence and acceptable at B1.
items.evidence: q1 A from 'mijn manager heeft gevraagd of ik zijn werk wil overnemen. Dat wil ik graag, maar daarvoor heb ik een diploma op niveau drie nodig.'; B ('niet meer geldig') is anchored in 'dat is al tien jaar geleden' and never said, C reverses 'bij je eigen bedrijf blijven? Ja, graag.' q2 B from 'De rest leer je op je werk. Je krijgt opdrachten die je met je eigen team uitvoert' with 'één avond per week naar school'; A's stage is only for someone without a job ('voor jou is dat niet nodig'), C reverses where the lessons are. q3 C from 'Drie maanden klinkt aantrekkelijk, want dan ben ik snel klaar. Maar mijn manager heeft duidelijk gezegd dat hij een diploma wil.'; A takes the adviser's exemption for his judgement, B is contradicted by 'klinkt aantrekkelijk'. q4 B from 'elfhonderd euro. Daar komt nog ongeveer tweehonderd euro bij'; A is the lesgeld alone, C adds the certificate's zeshonderd. q5 C from 'Dan maakt hij bij de intake een korte taaltoets, een uurtje op de computer.'; A refuted by 'Nee, de toets bij ons is genoeg.', B reverses the order and drops the condition. q6 A from 'Nee, meld je juist alvast aan. De aanmelding kost niets en je zit nergens aan vast.' with 'uiterlijk vijftien december' in the same fragment; B is Karim's rejected proposal, C the consequence of waiting. q7 B from 'Hoewel die langer duurt en meer kost, heb ik dan een diploma dat overal geldig is. Met het certificaat ben ik bang dat ik over een jaar toch weer hier zit.'; A is the reversal from q3, C is contradicted by 'Ik denk de opleiding van een jaar'.
items.distractor_test: All fourteen distractors are anchored in the fragment and clearly false: five 'said but answers another question' (q1 B, q2 A, q3 A, q4 A, q4 C), five reversals (q1 C, q2 C, q3 B, q5 B, q7 A), two contradicted proposals or consequences (q6 B, q6 C), two refuted by an explicit answer (q5 A, q7 C). Options parallel per question (sentences 10–13 words, infinitives 6–12 words, amounts 3 words); key longest only in q3 by one word and three characters.
items.coherence: One conversation from greeting to 'Tot ziens'; every prompt answerable from its own fragment; Karim's plan consistent across q6 and q7; his choice follows the adviser's 'Vraag dat eerst na' in q3.
items.content: Fictional college and employer; no names, brands or addresses; Karim and Modibo from the cast; Mevrouw Jansen generic. College procedures (assignments at the employer, employer funding with an agreement, instalments, intake language test with a module, Staatsexamen NT2 I as the language level) are realistic and stated as this college's rules. Nothing from the §9 avoid list; female authority figure.

items.level_reason: Instructief text with two sequence items whose competing step is said in the same turn (q1, q5), two persona rule items whose competing rule is said in the same fragment (cold versus buikgriep in q3, card versus tablet in q5, ordinary plaster in q2), an opinion tied to one specific break (q4) and a whole-text inference that needs the restaurant thread from three fragments (q6); Hasan's sentences average 11 words with 42% at 12 or more and the widest connector set in the batch; q5 on the easy side because the first step is the first thing said.
items.natural_dutch: Idiomatic supervisor Dutch ('Ik loop eerst de regels met je door', 'Zelf bellen doe je nooit', 'Ik heb liever dat je tien keer vraagt dan dat je één keer gokt.'); Roos short and plausible, never uses a pronoun for Hasan. Optional turns: 'Anders staan er die dag geen uren voor je.' for 'geen werktijd'; 'een paslezer naast de deur' so 'kastje' is not used for both the clock-in device and the locker; drop 'bij de band,' in q4 so the sentence stops implying the band people all leave while the band never stops. Recommended: the intro places the talk 'in de keuken' while the text's own rule keeps Roos out of the kitchen until she has changed.
items.evidence: q1 B from 'Na het inklokken ga je naar de kleedkamer. Je werkkleding ligt daar in je kastje: kleding aan, haarnetje op, sieraden uit.'; A is the later step ('Pas daarna … was je eerst je handen'), C the rule for a forgotten clock-in. q2 A from 'Dan meld je het bij mij en plak je een blauwe pleister uit de verbanddoos.' plus, two sentences later, 'Daaroverheen draag je een handschoen zolang de wond open is' (not in the quote: required edit); B forbidden in so many words, C overgeneralises 'zolang de wond open is'. q3 C from 'Bij buikgriep blijf je thuis, en je mag pas twee dagen nadat je beter bent weer in de keuken werken.' confirmed by 'Ja, ook dan'; A borrows the sick-call rule, B the cold rule. q4 B from 'Een kwartier is wel kort, vind ik. Net genoeg voor een kop koffie.'; A reverses 'mag ik naar buiten? Ja', C is true of Roos but about the lunch. q5 C from 'Dan zet je hem uit en hang je het rode kaartje eraan, dat naast elke machine hangt.' with 'Daarna schrijf je het op het tablet' proving the rank (recommended to add to the quote); A is the second step, B excluded twice. q6 A from 'In het restaurant waar ik werkte, was het minder streng, maar ik snap wel waarom het hier zo is.'; B overgeneralises q1's 'nog nooit in een ziekenhuis gewerkt', C reverses 'minder streng'.
items.distractor_test: All twelve distractors anchored and clearly false: later or second step (q1 A, q5 A), rule for another case (q1 C, q3 A, q3 B), explicitly forbidden (q2 B, q5 B), overgeneralisation (q2 C, q6 B), reversal (q4 A, q6 C), true but about another question (q4 C). Options parallel per question; key the shortest in q4, longest only in q6 by four characters, never by word count.
items.coherence: One morning briefing with a beginning and an end; the restaurant comparison runs through q2, q5 and q6; Roos's group (bij de broodjes) and Fatima's station agree; every prompt answerable from its own fragment. The intro's 'in de keuken' contradicts the text's own entry rule (recommended edit).
items.content: House rules of a fictional hospital kitchen (blue detectable plaster with a glove, no jewellery or nail polish, hand washing after breaks and toilet, two symptom-free days after buikgriep, a cold kept away from food, red out-of-order card and fault log, no self-repair): standard institutional food-safety practice, presented as this kitchen's rules, no medical advice, nothing graphic. Cast names Hasan, Roos, Fatima; no organisation, brand or address; male authority figure balancing text 1.

author_doubts_decisions.decision: Keep. Blueprint §8 gives the cast as a style, not a closed list; the illustration cast matters only where a still is drawn and B1 listening texts carry none; title plus surname suits an adviser addressed with 'u' (as Meneer Yilmaz in 012); 'Jansen' is generic. author_doubts_decisions.doubt: Staatsexamen programma één named as the language requirement
author_doubts_decisions.decision: Keep. Accurate for Dutch colleges (B1 / NT2 Programma I for adult second-language applicants to level-3 courses, or an intake computer test with a preparatory module) and stated as this college's rule; blueprint §8 allows a real institution when the item is about it; the fact is stable; it avoids the TTS-unsafe token 'B1'. The fallback 'op het niveau van de inburgering' would be less accurate (A2 or B1).

author_doubts_decisions.doubt: Closing questions labelled inference although the key is explicit
author_doubts_decisions.decision: Keep both labels. The evidence rule forces verbatim support in the last fragment, as in the official 'Wat blijkt uit het gesprek?' items; the inference lies in rejecting distractors that need earlier fragments and, in text 1, in 'zekerheid', which is never said. Relabelling to summary would leave a text without an inference item.

Pass. Blue detectable plasters with a glove, no jewellery or nail polish, hand washing after breaks and toilet, a cold kept away from food and two symptom-free days after buikgriep are standard institutional food-safety practice; presented as house rules, no medical advice, nothing graphic.

diversity_review: Within the batch the two texts differ in setting, purpose, information structure and skills (advice conversation about a choice with sums, a third-person rule, advice and a decision; first-day instruction with sequences, persona rules, a rota opinion and a comparison). With sibling batch 012 the four blueprint-shaped B1 listening texts cover all four task types, three text types (no persuasief yet), all three domains and four different voice pairs. No B1 listening setting from blueprint §9 is repeated; neighbourhood and volunteering unused. Cross-part echoes, acceptable because parts never share a set: logistiek describes the same college procedure as B1 reading batch011-deeltijdopleiding from another channel (one evening a week, placement for the jobless, one-hour intake language test with a module, fee plus books, employer pays with an agreement, instalments, September/February starts, website registration, intake with diplomas, exemptions) with different tested facts and figures; the author's notes wrongly say 'no niveautest'. ziekenhuiskeuken shares the first-day frame with A2 listening batch005-werkdag (six of seven elements in the same order) with no shared key. The adult-course-at-a-college motif now also carries B1 writing batch014-studieadviseur and batch015-avondcursus and B1 speaking batch017-cursusverzoek; the sick-leave, rota and machine motifs carry B1 reading batch011-verlofregeling, writing batch014-ziekmelding and batch015-pauzerooster, speaking batch017-machinestoring. Steer the next B1 batches to other settings.
